The Kinetic Processing Array is today's master of steam thrift, and its core virtue is one word: save. It takes §csuperheated steam only§r — plain steam need not apply; the energy discount digs deeper with gear tiers, pipe tiers squeeze recipe times, and parallelism grows with tier and stacks.

The steam rate also slides as voltage climbs — §3the higher the tier, the thriftier§r. Tinker with the tier setup twice and the feel comes fast; details in the tooltip.

Every liter saved is pure profit.

§3One KPA replaces a machine hall.§r
